_comment: Basic_Program round-trip regression portfolio. Feature-diverse minimum set covering every round-trip dimension the family exercises >=2x: single/multi-voice, legato/gated, play-once/loop, voiceless-const mask (bp_has_masks), freq-collision alphabet, start-frame offset, NTSC clock flag (60Hz). dur = songlength*1.1 (capped 120) = the family-batch verify window. Verdict = full SID->USF->SID round-trip FULL (pipelines.basic_program.usf_roundtrip.roundtrip).
